author: Preeti
message: I love the analogy here - it does a great job of articulating how change influences everyone. A challenge I see is around the perception of both the ice cube and the soup (my goal is to get the soup super cold and you're going to freeze me). However, reality is we are going to meet an equilibrium. And the challenge is in understanding that the goal is equilibrium and not either of the extremes that each party perceives.
